title: Add a debounced search box to the dashboard
description: Wraps the dashboard search field so queries are only sent once the user pauses typing, instead of on every keystroke.

expected.note: The effect reads `query` but its dependency array is empty, so the timeout closure captures the first render's `query` forever and `onResults` is always called with the initial (empty) value. Add `query` (and `onResults`) to the dependency array.
